name: Accounts payable and receivable specialist
summary: Gets invoices out right, gets them paid on time and checks supplier bills before they are paid. Keeps chasing polite and payments safe.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 checked sources (UK and EU late payment rules, the UK Late Payments Bill, e-invoicing dates in the EU, Belgium, France and the UK, US vendor and ACH rules, payment fraud data, plus where to check in India, Canada and Australia), four skills, six prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs. Access follows the three access levels; payments and bank detail changes are prepared at level 2 and released by the client.
